programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Crack open a mussel or two, this episode of Up the Dish begins in Belgium, but please, no waffles! Host Micah Trainor makes Moules- Frites, mussels steamed in white wine and shows her trick for bistro- style French fries. Next, Tiera Singh steals the show with her Mussel Broth Vichyssoise and Smoked Mussels, an ultra-creamy cold soup that's paired with smoky shellfish for fantastic flavour. Vegetarian mussels? Missy Hui says "no worries!" and makes Saffron Artichokes with zesty Lemon Chili Oil - there's a little bit of everything in each delectable bite! How does Poppy Sandler send the episode off? By turning it on its head! Fried mussels with Celeriac Remoulade salad makes for a satisfying ending to Up the Dish.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there; Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna; layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this "C" challenge, Chef Robert Jewell cooks up recipes using coconut and crab before combining both into a single recipe. Using sweet coconut, Robert makes a classic dessert -- an irresistible coconut cream pie. He starts with a delectable crunchy graham cracker crust and tops his pie with fluffy whipped cream and toasted coconut flakes. Next, Robert transforms a fresh soft-shell crab into a delicious, spicy, and crunchy dish. The best part? It's fast and easy to make. After soaking the crab in milk, Robert dunks it into a flour-cornmeal mixture and fries it until golden brown. But that's not all, Robert whips up the perfect dipping sauce, using spicy smoked- jalapeno, lime, and orange adobo mayo. Finally, Robert brings coconut and crab into one delicious dish.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: It's all about sesame and scallops in this letter "S" challenge, and host Theresa Visintin has some appetizing ideas up her sleeve. First, she shows us how to make scallop cassoulet, a simple recipe that can be cooked even faster than it can eaten! Theresa browns the tender scallops in delicious bacon fat and then bakes it on a bed of creamy kidney beans. Next, Theresa uses sesame seeds to create a zesty sauce for a take-out favourite, made in your very own kitchen - noodles! For her final recipe, our culinary host combines sesame and scallops, creating a juicy, crunchy masterpiece.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Tea and turkey are an unlikely combo for a meal, but Chef Robert Jewell is a creative force in the kitchen. First, he gives earl grey and lavender tea a sweet treatment by making a rich semifreddo. Robert creates a silky tea infused syrup, which he drizzles over a luxurious custard and tops with whipped cream. Robert punches up the colour by adding tart poached raspberries and vibrant violet lavender petals. Now, it's time for a real show stopper - saffron turkey kebabs with pomegranate rice. This is not your average turkey dinner. First, Robert marinates the turkey pieces in lime, yogourt and garlic. After infusing basmati rice with aromatic saffron and bay leaves, Robert tosses the rice with crunchy pine nuts and sweet pomegranate - the perfect bed for his grilled to- perfection turkey skewers. Robert then takes his culinary skills to the next level when he uses tea and turkey in one single delicious dish.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nürburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: From 2006 to 2012 the German company Artega produced their GT sports car model. Thanks to the know-how of a former Porsche and BMW manager the Artega GT was able to be manufactured in a small series.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Mustang celebrates its 50th anniversary at the Las Vegas Raceways and Marco takes part in this special event. He witnesses how tailor-made Shelby Cobras are manufactured and continues on his road trip through the US.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: New Age vs. Oldschool - The BMW i8 in L.A
programme.desc: How do conservative Californian petrolheads respond to a modern hybrid sports car like the BMW i8? On Marco's road trip through L.A. octane junkies who usually drive a Porsche 911, a Corvette or tuned bikes take the BMW to the test.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Special Cars Berlin - US Car Dreams
programme.desc: Kati from Munich is a big fan of US cars. She and her boyfriend fulfilled their dreams by buying a 1972 Chevy Chevelle that was found and imported directly from the USA by Frank Slopianka and his company Special Cars Berlin.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Not far from Stuttgart is the home of the tuner Performmaster who specialize in the performance optimization of Mercedes-AMG models. They turned the already more-than-potent GT S sports car into a beast.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: After the Second World War, following in his father's footsteps who had been responsible for the development of the classic Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche laid the foundation for the brand's sports car models like the 356 and later the Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: One cannot talk about rally sports without mentioning the name Walter Röhrl. From an early age, Röhrl showed his talent in rally sports and won the European, World and other international rally championships several times in his career.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Hans-Joachim Stuck is one of the best racing drivers in Germany. Over his long career he not only won the Formula II and several international touring car championships multiple times but also the famous 24-hour race of Le Mans twice.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The compact cars Mercedes A45 AMG Performmaster and MTM Audi RS3 R are loud, fast and extremely honed. In addition we examine the myth of Ferrari and take a look behind the scenes of the Rolls Royce Bespoke production.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The Route 66 from Chicago to Santa Monica is the most legendary road in the world. Following the old Highway you can experience the myth behind this former arterial road. Plus: A double-pack of GTR with the Nissan GTR and Mercedes-AMG GT R.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: With its Model S, American carmaker Tesla wants to establish electric engines in the full-size class. For the first time it is possible to attain driving ranges over 400 kilometers. And: with its Panamera Sport Turismo, Porsche taps into a new market.

programme.title: Toyota GT86 J-Sport
programme.desc: With the Toyota GT 86 from J-Sport, it is noticeable that the company's roots lie in racing. The fans' wish to give the Japanese racer significantly more power nevertheless remained unfulfilled.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Jaguar XF-S is supposed to put pressure on BMW, Audi and the other competitors in the business class segment. Volvo take a different approach. Their S90 is captivating due to its Scandinavian design and economical four-cylinder engines.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: BMW offers the X2 as a compact hipster SUV for young people. The DS 7 Crossback, on the other hand, wants to convey the French lifestyle. And Jaguar's E-Pace enters the market as a smaller version of the F-Pace.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: With the compact SUV Velar, Range Rover attempts to reach a broader audience. Jeep relies on the tried and tested: the design of the Wrangler has remained almost the same for more than 60 years. Also: the Volvo XC60 and the Ford Edge.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter still is one of the most popular commercial vehicles. For its third generation, the brand chose to have it manufactured in Poland. Before, this iconic van shared its production line with Volkswagen's Crafter.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Porsche quits the diesel business. Hybrids such as the Cayenne E-Hybrid are expected to become their focus of attention. Also: taking the BMW X4 on tour around Spartanburg, USA. And: mountain climbing with the Volkswagen Touareg in Austria.

programme.title: Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10
programme.desc: The ice course on Lungauring, the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10 in winter training. Twelve participants in six Evos were taught the art of drifting with a four-wheel drive car. We accompanied a student on his first drifting experience.

programme.title: Joseph Stalin's ZIS 110
programme.desc: James Bond still didn't have a license to kill, when this representative Russian vehicle called ZIS 110 rolled off the production line in 1949. The 110 was developed by reverse engineering a 1942 Packard Super Eight.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: At the end of the 1960s, under adverse conditions, Heinz Melkus built the GDR's only sports car, the Melkus RS 1000 with lightweight plastic bodywork and gullwing doors. Also: Audi resurrects the Wanderer streamline racing cars.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Samba transforms from pack mule into high-priced classic. And: a former letter box with 37 seats. The 1962 'Graf and Stift' post bus now takes tourists to their hotel.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The BMW 503 four-seater convertible is one of BMW's most exclusive models. Also: Inspector Columbo's Peugeot 403 Cabrio. And: pre-war elegance with 1950s technology, the Mercedes S 170.
